name: Mile High Megacomp 2023
information:
REGISTRATION:

Any requested changes to registration before the deadline will be honored. Your registration is not complete until your name shows up on the list. If you believe you paid and your name isn't showing up, please contact us and we will work it out.

[//]: # (The registration fee will be $30 per competitor and there is a competitor limit of 250. Registration will open on Monday January 9th at 6pm MST and will close on February 24th, 2022 or **when the competitor limit is reached. **)
[//]: # (Competitors MUST register and pay online in order to compete. No at-the-door registrations or payments will be accepted. )
[//]: # (ALL SPECTATORS ARE WELCOME TO ATTEND FOR FREE.)

Please read the "Competitor Information" tab before registering.
